name: simple-drawing-pad
description: For Windows PCs: sketch an idea by hand and paste it to Claude or any app. Ctrl+Alt+D opens the drawing window, Enter copies, Ctrl+V pastes. Simple as that. It needs a small helper program on your computer, built from the included source (nothing downloaded, no admin rights): it starts with Windows, works only locally (no network, collects nothing) and keeps your last 10 drawings. The plugin asks once per computer before installing it, and a short local check at each session start tells Claude whether it works. Remove the helper in Windows Settings > Apps or with /simple-drawing-pad:uninstall. On macOS and Linux only a simple offline browser board is available.
